theorem QOU.BraidsAndKnots.YoungDiagramTransposeBridge.kernel_summand_conj_mem (k : ℕ) (l : List ℕ) (hl : l ∈ YoungDiagramKernel.partsOf k) :
↑(YoungDiagramKernel.sytDim (YoungDiagramKernel.conj l)) ^ 3 * YoungDiagramKernel.omega3 k (YoungDiagramKernel.conj l) = ↑(YoungDiagramKernel.sytDim l) ^ 3 * YoungDiagramKernel.omega3 k l

theorem QOU.BraidsAndKnots.YoungDiagramTransposeBridge.kernelValue_conj_reindex (k : ℕ) :
(List.map (fun (l : List ℕ) => ↑(YoungDiagramKernel.sytDim (YoungDiagramKernel.conj l)) ^ 3 * (YoungDiagramKernel.contentSq (YoungDiagramKernel.conj l) - ↑(k * (k - 1) / 2))) (YoungDiagramKernel.partsOf k)).sum = YoungDiagramKernel.kernelValue k

theorem QOU.BraidsAndKnots.YoungDiagramTransposeBridge.sum_map_conj (k : ℕ) (g : List ℕ → ℤ) :
(List.map (fun (l : List ℕ) => g (YoungDiagramKernel.conj l)) (YoungDiagramKernel.partsOf k)).sum = (List.map g (YoungDiagramKernel.partsOf k)).sum

theorem QOU.BraidsAndKnots.YoungDiagramTransposeBridge.map_conj_perm (k : ℕ) :
(List.map YoungDiagramKernel.conj (YoungDiagramKernel.partsOf k)).Perm (YoungDiagramKernel.partsOf k)

theorem QOU.BraidsAndKnots.YoungDiagramTransposeBridge.conj_mem_partsOf (k : ℕ) (l : List ℕ) (hl : l ∈ YoungDiagramKernel.partsOf k) :
YoungDiagramKernel.conj l ∈ YoungDiagramKernel.partsOf k

theorem QOU.BraidsAndKnots.YoungDiagramTransposeBridge.conj_pos (l : List ℕ) (x : ℕ) (hx : x ∈ YoungDiagramKernel.conj l) :
0 < x

theorem QOU.BraidsAndKnots.YoungDiagramTransposeBridge.length_le_sum (l : List ℕ) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ l, 0 < x) :
l.length ≤ l.sum

theorem QOU.BraidsAndKnots.YoungDiagramTransposeBridge.partsFuel_nodup (f n maxP : ℕ) :
(YoungDiagramKernel.partsFuel f n maxP).Nodup

theorem QOU.BraidsAndKnots.YoungDiagramTransposeBridge.nodup_flatMap_cons (xs : List ℕ) (F : ℕ → List (List ℕ)) (hxs : xs.Nodup) (hF : ∀ (i : ℕ), (F i).Nodup) :
(List.flatMap (fun (i : ℕ) => List.map (fun (x : List ℕ) => i :: x) (F i)) xs).Nodup

theorem QOU.BraidsAndKnots.YoungDiagramTransposeBridge.mem_partsFuel (l : List ℕ) (f n maxP : ℕ) :
l.sum = n → (∀ x ∈ l, 0 < x) → (∀ x ∈ l, x ≤ maxP) → List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) l → l.length ≤ f → l ∈ YoungDiagramKernel.partsFuel f n maxP

theorem QOU.BraidsAndKnots.YoungDiagramTransposeBridge.partsOf_facts (k : ℕ) (l : List ℕ) (hl : l ∈ YoungDiagramKernel.partsOf k) :
l.sum = k ∧ (∀ x ∈ l, 0 < x) ∧ List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) l

theorem QOU.BraidsAndKnots.YoungDiagramTransposeBridge.partsFuel_mem (f n maxP : ℕ) (l : List ℕ) :
l ∈ YoungDiagramKernel.partsFuel f n maxP → l.sum = n ∧ (∀ x ∈ l, 0 < x) ∧ (∀ x ∈ l, x ≤ maxP) ∧ List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) l

theorem QOU.BraidsAndKnots.YoungDiagramTransposeBridge.kernel_summand_conj (k : ℕ) (l : List ℕ) (hs : List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) l) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ l, 0 < x) :
↑(YoungDiagramKernel.sytDim (YoungDiagramKernel.conj l)) ^ 3 * YoungDiagramKernel.omega3 k (YoungDiagramKernel.conj l) = ↑(YoungDiagramKernel.sytDim l) ^ 3 * YoungDiagramKernel.omega3 k l

theorem QOU.BraidsAndKnots.YoungDiagramTransposeBridge.sytDim_conj (l : List ℕ) (hs : List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) l) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ l, 0 < x) :
YoungDiagramKernel.sytDim (YoungDiagramKernel.conj l) = YoungDiagramKernel.sytDim l

theorem QOU.BraidsAndKnots.YoungDiagramTransposeBridge.hookProd_conj (l : List ℕ) (hs : List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) l) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ l, 0 < x) :
YoungDiagramKernel.hookProd (YoungDiagramKernel.conj l) = YoungDiagramKernel.hookProd l

theorem QOU.BraidsAndKnots.YoungDiagramTransposeBridge.hookProd_eq_prod_cells (l : List ℕ) :
YoungDiagramKernel.hookProd l = ∏ p ∈ cells l, (l.getD p.1 0 + (YoungDiagramKernel.conj l).getD p.2 0 - p.2 - p.1 - 1)

theorem QOU.BraidsAndKnots.YoungDiagramTransposeBridge.list_prod_map_range (n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ) :
(List.map f (List.range n)).prod = ∏ j ∈ Finset.range n, f j

theorem QOU.BraidsAndKnots.YoungDiagramTransposeBridge.sum_conj (l : List ℕ) (hs : List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) l) :
(YoungDiagramKernel.conj l).sum = l.sum

theorem QOU.BraidsAndKnots.YoungDiagramTransposeBridge.card_cells (l : List ℕ) :
(cells l).card = l.sum

theorem QOU.BraidsAndKnots.YoungDiagramTransposeBridge.sum_getD_range (l : List ℕ) :
∑ i ∈ Finset.range l.length, l.getD i 0 = l.sum

theorem QOU.BraidsAndKnots.YoungDiagramTransposeBridge.conj_conj (l : List ℕ) (hs : List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) l) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ l, 0 < x) :
YoungDiagramKernel.conj (YoungDiagramKernel.conj l) = l

theorem QOU.BraidsAndKnots.YoungDiagramTransposeBridge.countP_conj (l : List ℕ) (hs : List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) l) (c : ℕ) :
List.countP (fun (x : ℕ) => decide (c < x)) (YoungDiagramKernel.conj l) = min (l.headD 0) (l.getD c 0)

theorem QOU.BraidsAndKnots.YoungDiagramTransposeBridge.countP_range_lt (n k : ℕ) :
List.countP (fun (j : ℕ) => decide (j < k)) (List.range n) = min n k

theorem QOU.BraidsAndKnots.YoungDiagramTransposeBridge.conj_sorted (m : List ℕ) :
List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) (YoungDiagramKernel.conj m)

theorem QOU.BraidsAndKnots.YoungDiagramTransposeBridge.length_conj (m : List ℕ) :
(YoungDiagramKernel.conj m).length = m.headD 0

theorem QOU.BraidsAndKnots.YoungDiagramTransposeBridge.getD_zero_eq_headD (m : List ℕ) :
m.getD 0 0 = m.headD 0

theorem QOU.BraidsAndKnots.YoungDiagramTransposeBridge.omega3_conj (k : ℕ) (l : List ℕ) (hs : List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) l) :
YoungDiagramKernel.omega3 k (YoungDiagramKernel.conj l) = YoungDiagramKernel.omega3 k l

theorem QOU.BraidsAndKnots.YoungDiagramTransposeBridge.contentSq_conj (l : List ℕ) (hs : List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) l) :
YoungDiagramKernel.contentSq (YoungDiagramKernel.conj l) = YoungDiagramKernel.contentSq l

theorem QOU.BraidsAndKnots.YoungDiagramTransposeBridge.cells_conj (l : List ℕ) (hs : List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) l) :
cells (YoungDiagramKernel.conj l) = YoungDiagramTranspose.transpose (cells l)

theorem QOU.BraidsAndKnots.YoungDiagramTransposeBridge.mem_transpose (D : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)) (p : ℕ × ℕ) :
p ∈ YoungDiagramTranspose.transpose D ↔ p.swap ∈ D

theorem QOU.BraidsAndKnots.YoungDiagramTransposeBridge.conj_getD (l : List ℕ) (hs : List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) l) (c : ℕ) :
(YoungDiagramKernel.conj l).getD c 0 = List.countP (fun (x : ℕ) => decide (c < x)) l

theorem QOU.BraidsAndKnots.YoungDiagramTransposeBridge.lt_countP_iff (l : List ℕ) (hs : List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) l) (r c : ℕ) :
c < List.countP (fun (x : ℕ) => decide (r < x)) l ↔ r < l.getD c 0

theorem QOU.BraidsAndKnots.YoungDiagramTransposeBridge.mem_le_headD (l : List ℕ) (hs : List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) l) (x : ℕ) (hx : x ∈ l) :
x ≤ l.headD 0

theorem QOU.BraidsAndKnots.YoungDiagramTransposeBridge.contentSq_eq_csq (l : List ℕ) :
YoungDiagramKernel.contentSq l = YoungDiagramTranspose.csq (cells l)

theorem QOU.BraidsAndKnots.YoungDiagramTransposeBridge.contentSq_eq_finset_sum (l : List ℕ) :
YoungDiagramKernel.contentSq l = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range l.length, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (l.getD i 0), (↑j - ↑i) ^ 2

theorem QOU.BraidsAndKnots.YoungDiagramTransposeBridge.inner_row_sum (n i : ℕ) :
(List.map (fun (j : ℤ) => (j - ↑i) ^ 2) do let a ← List.range n pure ↑a).sum = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, (↑j - ↑i) ^ 2

theorem QOU.BraidsAndKnots.YoungDiagramTransposeBridge.list_sum_map_range (n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℤ) :
(List.map f (List.range n)).sum = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, f j

theorem QOU.BraidsAndKnots.YoungDiagramTransposeBridge.mem_cells (l : List ℕ) (p : ℕ × ℕ) :
p ∈ cells l ↔ p.2 < l.getD p.1 0

def QOU.BraidsAndKnots.YoungDiagramTransposeBridge.cells (l : List ℕ) :
Finset (ℕ × ℕ)
